comment:
* Fancy progress indicator for Material theme.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: CENTER_RADIUS
variables.comment: should add up to 10 when + stroke_width

variables.name: COLOR_START_DELAY_OFFSET
variables.comment:
* The value in the linear interpolator for animating the drawable at which
     * the color transition should start

variables.name: ANIMATION_DURATION
variables.comment: The duration of a single progress spin in milliseconds.

variables.name: NUM_POINTS
variables.comment: The number of points in the progress "star".

variables.name: mAnimators
variables.comment: The list of animators operating on this drawable.

variables.name: mRing
variables.comment: The indicator ring, used to manage animation state.

variables.name: ARROW_WIDTH
variables.comment: Layout info for the arrowhead in dp

variables.name: ARROW_WIDTH_LARGE
variables.comment: Layout info for the arrowhead for the large spinner in dp
